command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp

# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
# PATH export IS needed: aarchbio images have their PATH dropped by the task shell.
#
# NOTHING NEW IS STAGED. This runs on the GIAB chr20 fixture already staged for gatk4,
# bcftools and freebayes -- same BAM, same reference, same truth set -- so Clair3 becomes a
# fourth caller in an existing comparison rather than a parallel universe with its own inputs.

echo "== the BAM must be the exact bytes the other callers used =="
printf '%s  NA12878.chr20.30x.bam\n' 0ad228c159e7f3b060d3476226f27b016b051f03eb73003f8929c5f954e1e02c > pins.sha256
sha256sum -c pins.sha256 || { echo "FAIL: BAM differs from what the other callers scored"; exit 1; }

run_clair3.sh --version 2>&1 | head -2

# The ilmn model is BUNDLED in this image at /opt/conda/bin/models/ilmn -- established by a
# probe before this recipe was designed, because which models a build ships is a property of
# the image. 21 models are present (ilmn, hifi, and 15+ ONT), which is why the package is
# 429 MB. So no model download, and the run is fully offline.
test -d /opt/conda/bin/models/ilmn || { echo "FAIL: the bundled ilmn model is missing"; exit 1; }
ls /opt/conda/bin/models/ilmn | head -5 | sed 's/^/  model file: /'

echo "== Clair3 on the whole of chr20, Illumina model =="
T0=$(date +%s)
run_clair3.sh \
  --bam_fn=NA12878.chr20.30x.bam \
  --ref_fn=chr20.fa \
  --threads="$(nproc)" \
  --platform=ilmn \
  --model_path=/opt/conda/bin/models/ilmn \
  --ctg_name=chr20 \
  --output=/tmp/clair3_out > clair3.log 2>&1
RC=$?
T1=$(date +%s)
WALL=$((T1-T0))
printf 'clair3_rc\t%s\n' "$RC"
printf 'clair3_wall_s\t%s\n' "$WALL"
if [ "$RC" != "0" ]; then tail -40 clair3.log; echo "FAIL: Clair3 exited $RC"; exit 1; fi

VCF=/tmp/clair3_out/merge_output.vcf.gz
test -s "$VCF" || { ls -l /tmp/clair3_out | head -20; echo "FAIL: no merge_output.vcf.gz"; exit 1; }
cp "$VCF" clair3.vcf.gz
[ -s "$VCF.tbi" ] && cp "$VCF.tbi" clair3.vcf.gz.tbi

# Structural checks, the same ones the gatk4 recipe makes: this is not the correctness bar --
# that is the GIAB concordance in task 2 -- but a VCF that is single-sample, entirely on chr20
# and indexed is a precondition for the comparison meaning anything.
zcat clair3.vcf.gz > c.vcf
# CLAIR3's merge_output.vcf.gz IS NOT A VARIANT SET. It is a decision log: alongside PASS calls
# it emits a RefCall row for every position it examined and judged reference. Measured here:
# 179,453 RefCall against 118,312 PASS. Counting all rows as "variants" overstates the call set
# by 2.5x and would let a scorer treat every reference call as a false positive. GATK4 has no
# such concept, so the two are only comparable once Clair3 is restricted to PASS.
ALLROWS=$(grep -vc '^#' c.vcf || true)
REFCALL=$(awk '!/^#/ && $7=="RefCall"' c.vcf | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
TOTAL=$(awk '!/^#/ && $7=="PASS"' c.vcf | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
SNV=$(awk '!/^#/ && $7=="PASS" && length($4)==1 && length($5)==1' c.vcf | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
printf 'all_rows\t%s\n' "$ALLROWS"
printf 'refcall_rows\t%s\tnot variants -- positions called reference\n' "$REFCALL"
NONCHR20=$(awk '!/^#/ && $1!="chr20"' c.vcf | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
NSAMP=$(awk '/^#CHROM/{print NF-9; exit}' c.vcf)
HASTBI=0; [ -s clair3.vcf.gz.tbi ] && HASTBI=1
printf 'pass_variants\t%s\n' "$TOTAL"
printf 'pass_snv_count\t%s\n' "$SNV"
printf 'all_on_chr20\t%s\twant 0\n' "$NONCHR20"
printf 'sample_columns\t%s\twant 1\n' "$NSAMP"
printf 'vcf_index\t%s\twant 1\n' "$HASTBI"
test "$NONCHR20" -eq 0 || { echo "FAIL: $NONCHR20 calls off chr20"; exit 1; }
test "$NSAMP" -eq 1 || { echo "FAIL: $NSAMP sample columns, expected 1"; exit 1; }
test "$TOTAL" -gt 50000 || { echo "FAIL: only $TOTAL PASS variants on a 36x chromosome"; exit 1; }
test "$REFCALL" -gt 0 || { echo "FAIL: no RefCall rows -- is this really Clair3 output?"; exit 1; }
if [ "$HASTBI" != "1" ]; then
  bgzip -f -c c.vcf > clair3.vcf.gz && tabix -f -p vcf clair3.vcf.gz && HASTBI=1
  printf 'vcf_index_rebuilt\t%s\n' "$HASTBI"
fi
rm -f c.vcf

{ printf 'observable\tvalue\n'
  printf 'clair3_wall_s\t%s\n' "$WALL"
  printf 'pass_variants\t%s\n' "$TOTAL"
  printf 'pass_snv_count\t%s\n' "$SNV"; } > call_score.tsv
echo "CLAIR3 CALL OK"
